title: Cancer: current or history, and metastases
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's cancer as documented at this visit.
note:
Chief Complaint: Follow-up for history of right breast cancer.

HPI: Patient is a 77-year-old female who originally presented with a malignant neoplasm of the right breast. The primary tumor was surgically removed and treated several years ago. She reports she feels well and has had no new symptoms or concerns. Patient states she is no longer on any active treatment plans. No new concerns were reported during today's visit.

Medication List:
- Multivitamin daily
- Lisinopril 10mg daily

Vitals: BP 128/82, HR 74, SpO2 98% on room air, Temp 98.6 F, BMI 26.4

Review of Systems:
- Constitutional: Negative
- Cardiovascular: Negative
- Respiratory: Negative
- Gastrointestinal: Negative
- Musculoskeletal: Negative
- Neurological: Negative

Exam:
General: Well-appearing, alert, and oriented x3.
Breast: Right breast is stable. No masses or skin changes noted.
Lungs: Clear to auscultation.
Heart: Regular rate and rhythm.

Assessment:
1. History of right breast cancer. Treatment is complete. There is no evidence of local recurrence and no evidence of disease at the primary site.

Plan:
1. Continue routine monitoring.
2. Follow up in 12 months for routine screening.

Electronically signed, 
R. Mensah, PA-C
May 14, 2026
explanations: The right female breast cancer was excised or eradicated, no treatment is directed to it and there is no evidence of it: personal history Z85.3 (no HCC). Any metastasis is still coded as a current secondary malignancy.

distractors.why: Treatment ended and there is no evidence of the primary: code personal history (Z85), not active cancer.
